{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for the target population: new customers reached by paid_search
target_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check if any QA orders are in the target group
qa_in_target = target_df[target_df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders in target group: {len(qa_in_target)}')

# Check if any refunded orders are in the target group
refunded_in_target = target_df[target_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Refunded orders in target group: {len(refunded_in_target)}')

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders for the conversion rate calculation
# The question asks for conversion rate among NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH.
# The 'converted' column is 1 if checkout was completed. 
# Refunded orders are still 'converted' (they completed checkout), but are not real.
# QA orders are not real and should be excluded.

# Exclude QA orders and refunded orders
valid_target_df = target_df[~((target_df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99) | (target_df['status'] == 'refunded'))]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted in valid target group
conversion_rate = valid_target_df['converted'].mean()
print(f'Conversion rate among valid NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {conversion_rate}')"}
